sample.rule: first 16 queries in actual controller execution order; first two issue-width-8 batches; no replacements
sample.capture: new capture from initial packed resources through production controller; not reconstructed historical snapshots

controller.transaction_capacity: production backend node_count * partition_tasks; diagnostic one query node_count

modes.S: reexecute production same search on canonical current state then negotiated commit
modes.F: wide same search on batch snapshot; full actually loaded Resource fields plus path dependencies; bind immutable graph/task/all seeds; conservative field equality; on mismatch replay S; negotiated commit
modes.P: original path read checks and commit allow_overuse=0; changed contract vs normal controller; not equal-algorithm speed baseline
modes.N: original path reads and actual controller allow_overuse=1

canonical_replay: apply original batch candidates in priority/id commit order; each mode starts from same canonical pre-commit state; only N feeds canonical progression; compare canonical batch state to actual backend and next controller batch
capacity_reference: mechanical wide uint32 PathResult and no 65535 path count guard; same production heap/order/arith/tie; bounded vectors; optional 65535 exploration-record guard only for synthetic counterfactual; production ABI unchanged

timing.correctness: full state comparison/independent four replicas/hashes; diagnostic overhead included in subprocess ledger, not performance comparisons
timing.performance: separate invocation; one S F P N pass per frozen snapshot; no full state audit or hashes in timed sections; allocation included search_total; F fallback charged; input loading/state copy not in component times but included outer wall
timing.logical_bytes: F unique*(uint32 id + Resource16)=20; P/N unique ReadEntry8; no measured HBM bytes

resources.priority: nice +10; four relatively idle available CPUs

stops: any state/candidate/reference inconsistency: retain evidence; no performance interpretation
timeout or partial is not final legality
no result-driven resampling or parameter rescue

decision_rules.RESEARCH_GAP_SUPPORTED: all next-method admission conditions in task supported, including real overhead after capacity confound removal and concrete nontrivial ability
decision_rules.ENGINEERING_LIMIT_ONLY: capacity attribution supported on relevant traces and no additional bottleneck; do not extrapolate synthetic guard to old failures
decision_rules.CORRECTNESS_BLOCKED: actual declared input/controller contract state correctness failure
decision_rules.INSUFFICIENT_TRACE: old failure attribution or real bottleneck unresolved in fixed bounded traces; stop current submission-protocol hypothesis; no automatic extension

pre_run_commit: git commit containing this protocol and code; exact SHA recorded after commit in RUN_IDENTITY.json; do not self-substitute source SHA
